locator: I q.2 a.3 co., secunda via: quia sic esset prius seipso
interpretation: The suppressed premise of Aquinas' reason against self-causation: a cause is prior to its effect. The priority is read as q.3 a.1's simple priority (PriorSimply, priority of nature, not of time), since the per se causes of the second way act together, as hand and stick.
